{\footnotesize Median integrated $L^2(F)$ against the corrected reference: ABF \WcvAbfMedian,
practical mFR \WcvEstMedian, oracle mFR \WcvOracleMedian, sham \WcvShamMedian. Health at the
practical arm: min ancestor $\mathrm{ESS}/N = \WcsEstEss$ and max ancestor fraction
\WcsEstAnc, against preregistered floors of $0.10$ and $0.05$. The looser ESS floor than the
gateway's $0.30$ was declared in advance, because the accepted WCA configuration already runs
at $\mathrm{ESS}/N \approx 0.17$ and the gateway's floor would have failed the configuration
under test rather than tested it. The oracle-versus-its-own-sham contrast was not recomputed
against the corrected reference: the practical arm carries the preregistered attribution
